rules.rule: Published static website records contain public or low-risk commercial information only.
No keys, credentials, tokens, customer files, protected artifacts or sensitive personal data are allowed in repo or static site.
Managed Secure claims require validated identity, access, revocation, audit, isolation, backup/recovery and incident evidence.
Do not use vendor-branded product names that imply official partnership unless contractually true.
Root Bokmål and /en/ English content must use locale_strings and pass parity review.
